Map a store product to a product, so buying it grants the product's perks. Without arguments it asks
for both in a terminal, offering the store products not mapped yet.

A store product mapped to another product moves to this one with the purchases and subscriptions
recorded under it, as 'voidhash provider move' does; it shows what moves and asks first, and --yes
skips that. A product sells one store product per provider: when it already sells another, a
terminal asks whether to sell this one from now on or keep selling the other; --sell and --keep
answer for scripts, and without either it keeps the other one. A payment source whose test system
names products differently maps each key with --environment production or test.

Usage:
  voidhash provider map [store-product] [product] [flags]

Arguments:
  store-product  The store's id for it, as 'provider products' lists it (a Stripe price is
                 prod_...:price_...)
  product        The product buying it grants: its slug, name or id

Flags:
      --environment <all|production|test>
                                   For a payment source whose test system names products
                                   differently: the purchases this store product key names (default
                                   all). App Store and Google Play products name every environment,
                                   and a Stripe price's mode decides its own
  -h, --help                       Show help for this command
      --json                       Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --keep                       When the product already sells another store product of this
                                   provider, keep selling that one
      --offer <id=store-offer-id>  An offer a paywall can sell on it, as id=store-offer-id; repeat
                                   for each. Replaces the saved offers (can be repeated)
      --project <project>          Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                   (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
      --provider <provider>        The provider selling it (app-store, google-play, stripe, a
                                   payment source's slug); needed only when several do
  -q, --quiet                      Print only ids, one per line
      --sell                       When the product already sells another store product of this
                                   provider, sell this one from now on instead
  -y, --yes                        Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider map com.acme.pro.monthly pro-monthly
  voidhash provider map prod_123:price_456 pro-annual --provider stripe
  voidhash provider map com.acme.pro.monthly pro-monthly --offer win-back=WINBACK50
